vulnerable_code:
class UpdateShippingAddressMutation(graphene.Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        address_id = graphene.Int(required=True)
        street = graphene.String(required=True)
        city = graphene.String(required=True)
        zip_code = graphene.String(required=True)

    success = graphene.Boolean()
    address = graphene.Field(ShippingAddressType)

    def mutate(self, info, address_id, street, city, zip_code):
        if not info.context.user.is_authenticated:
            raise GraphQLError("Authentication required.")
        addr = ShippingAddress.objects.get(id=address_id)
        addr.street = street
        addr.city = city
        addr.zip_code = zip_code
        addr.save(update_fields=['street', 'city', 'zip_code'])
        return UpdateShippingAddressMutation(success=True, address=addr)
diagnosis: The GraphQL mutation retrieves ShippingAddress solely by address_id from mutation arguments and updates the delivery location. It fails to verify that addr.customer == info.context.user, allowing an authenticated attacker to alter other customers' shipping addresses and intercept package deliveries.
